note: USACE (Nashville District) on the Caney Fork River below Center Hill Dam, a stocked trout tailwater. The riverside row sits on a terrace behind a wooded bank about 5 m above the water; boat ramp and fish-cleaning station in the campground. --Claude
summary: USACE Center Hill tailwater. Confirmed $30 ($32 for sewer site 58), 50A + water, flush/showers/laundry/dump, rec.gov only, 14 nights per 30. Sites 60 -> 55 (catalog; 5 more are management), max_rig_ft 75 -> 156 (catalog), all back-in. Season 04-01..10-31 (derived) -> 04-08..10-31 (rate seasons). $3 extra-vehicle fee added. Riverview kept; pin and phone fine. Note trimmed of field repeats.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverview kept): rec.gov tags 12 sites Riverfront (01, 02, 06, 08, 10, 14, 18, 20, 22, 23, 24, 25; all sold by the night). Caney Fork here is ~70-75 m wide (a river, not a creek). Those pads sit on a terrace ~5 m above the tailwater (3DEP: site 22 at 36.1012,-85.8343 is 153.2 m, the water 147.8 m ~30 m away) with a continuous tree line on the bank (Esri) - no open apron and well past the kayak test, so a view, not riverfront.
POLICY ROW: federal:usace gives extra_vehicle amount 0; this campground posts $3 per additional vehicle or visitor vehicle - written per entry (the row's own note allows parking/visitor fees).
SITES max_rig_ft 156 comes from site 23's catalog Max Vehicle Length (next longest 103, then 96); it is the posted figure, odd as it is.
